groups.distinction: 在关注问题这一语境接近，均保留介词to；后面可接名词或动名词。
groups.before: Team members should pay attention to quieter colleagues' ideas.
groups.after: Team members should give attention to quieter colleagues' ideas.
groups.chinese_before: 团队成员应关注较少发言同事的想法。
groups.chinese_after: 团队成员应重视较少发言同事的想法。
groups.misuse: to在此为介词；接动词要用doing，不能直接接动词原形。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: discuss为及物动词，直接接话题；前者更口语。
groups.before: Team members should talk about the plan before acting.
groups.after: Team members should discuss the plan before acting.
groups.chinese_before: 团队成员应在行动前讨论计划。
groups.chinese_after: 团队成员应在行动前讨论计划。
groups.misuse: 不写discuss about the plan；talk to sb中的talk也不能直接这样换。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: restrict常强调加以约束；用于使用量时接近limit，但语气可能更强。
groups.before: Cities should limit the use of disposable plastic bags.
groups.after: Cities should restrict the use of disposable plastic bags.
groups.chinese_before: 城市应限制一次性塑料袋的使用。
groups.chinese_after: 城市应限制一次性塑料袋的使用。
groups.misuse: restrict不等于ban；限制不代表完全禁止。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: polluted明确表示受到污染；dirty仅表示不干净，范围更广。
groups.before: The river is dirty because of industrial waste.
groups.after: The river is polluted by industrial waste.
groups.chinese_before: 工业废物使这条河很脏。
groups.chinese_after: 这条河受到工业废物污染。
groups.misuse: 衣服沾灰通常用dirty，不应都写polluted；此处污染原因已明确。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: purify强调去除杂质或有害成分；比一般clean更具体，不能保证完全纯净。
groups.before: The system cleans the water by removing harmful substances.
groups.after: The system purifies the water by removing harmful substances.
groups.chinese_before: 系统通过去除有害物质清洁水体。
groups.chinese_after: 系统通过去除有害物质净化水体。
groups.misuse: 打扫房间用clean the room；不写purify the room来代替普通打扫。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: 在受到伤害威胁时接近；at risk of后接风险事件，不能省掉关键条件。
groups.before: Some species are in danger because their habitats are shrinking.
groups.after: Some species are at risk because their habitats are shrinking.
groups.chinese_before: 一些物种因栖息地缩小而处于危险中。
groups.chinese_after: 一些物种因栖息地缩小而面临风险。
groups.misuse: at risk不自动等于已发生损害；不应改写成have become extinct。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: 把宾语补足语结构转为名词结构，保留需要提高意识的人群。
groups.before: The campaign makes residents aware of food waste.
groups.after: The campaign raises residents' awareness of food waste.
groups.chinese_before: 这项活动让居民意识到食物浪费问题。
groups.chinese_after: 这项活动提高居民对食物浪费问题的认识。
groups.misuse: raise awareness不等于问题已经解决，不能删除后续行动。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: establish在创建制度、机制、机构时自然；建筑物实际施工可继续用build。
groups.before: The city plans to build a network of community services.
groups.after: The city plans to establish a network of community services.
groups.chinese_before: 城市计划建设社区服务网络。
groups.chinese_after: 城市计划建立社区服务网络。
groups.misuse: build a bridge的具体建造义不宜机械换成establish a bridge。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

essay_observations.source_type: 第三方范文中的表达观察；不是自编例句出处

groups.distinction: assist在帮助人做事时可替换support，但不包含赞同某种观点的含义。
groups.before: These volunteers support older residents in using online services.
groups.after: These volunteers assist older residents in using online services.
groups.chinese_before: 这些志愿者帮助老年居民使用在线服务。
groups.chinese_after: 这些志愿者协助老年居民使用在线服务。
groups.misuse: support a policy表示支持政策时不能改成assist a policy。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: poor可指收入低；disadvantaged指处于不利条件，范围可包含教育和机会，不是所有贫困的同义词。
groups.before: The programme helps students from poor families.
groups.after: The programme helps students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
groups.chinese_before: 这个项目帮助来自贫困家庭的学生。
groups.chinese_after: 这个项目帮助家庭或成长条件不利的学生。
groups.misuse: 后一表达扩大了范围；需要精确指低收入时用low-income families。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

essay_observations.source_type: 第三方范文中的表达观察；不是自编例句出处

groups.distinction: 在为某群体提供物品或服务时可转换，注意对象顺序。
groups.before: Libraries provide residents with free learning resources.
groups.after: Libraries provide free learning resources for residents.
groups.chinese_before: 图书馆为居民提供免费学习资源。
groups.chinese_after: 图书馆向居民提供免费的学习资源。
groups.misuse: 练习中优先使用with或for的完整搭配，明确提供物与接受者的关系。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: invest in增加期待未来回报或收益的含义，只在有这种目的时改写。
groups.before: The government spends money on education to improve future opportunities.
groups.after: The government invests in education to improve future opportunities.
groups.chinese_before: 政府在教育上花钱，以改善未来机会。
groups.chinese_after: 政府投资教育，以改善未来机会。
groups.misuse: 所有支出不一定是投资；没有长期收益含义时保留spend。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: ancient表示年代非常久远，比old强；用于古代历史对象时可用。
groups.before: The museum displays objects from very old civilizations.
groups.after: The museum displays objects from ancient civilizations.
groups.chinese_before: 博物馆展出年代十分久远的文明遗物。
groups.chinese_after: 博物馆展出古代文明遗物。
groups.misuse: 几十年前的流行歌曲通常是old songs，不能一概称ancient songs。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: maintain强调使某种状态持续；此处不是keep的保留物品或继续做事用法。
groups.before: Local communities work to keep the tradition alive.
groups.after: Local communities work to maintain the vitality of the tradition.
groups.chinese_before: 当地社区努力使传统保持活力。
groups.chinese_after: 当地社区努力维持传统的活力。
groups.misuse: 不写maintain doing来替换keep doing；maintain后接名词对象。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: value强调认为有价值、珍视；appreciate可强调理解其价值或欣赏。
groups.before: Students should value the diversity of local traditions.
groups.after: Students should appreciate the diversity of local traditions.
groups.chinese_before: 学生应珍视地方传统的多样性。
groups.chinese_after: 学生应理解并欣赏地方传统的多样性。
groups.misuse: appreciate还可表示感激；value不一定包含欣赏的体验，侧重略变。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: 传承知识、故事、技艺时接近，均可加to引出传承对象。
groups.before: Families hand down local stories to younger generations.
groups.after: Families pass on local stories to younger generations.
groups.chinese_before: 家庭把地方故事传给年轻一代。
groups.chinese_after: 家庭将地方故事传承给年轻一代。
groups.misuse: pass on information也可只是转告消息；不是每处都有文化传承含义。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

groups.distinction: renowned表示广为人知、有名望，强于普通known；需要有一定知名度依据。
groups.before: The town is known for its traditional crafts.
groups.after: The town is renowned for its traditional crafts.
groups.chinese_before: 这个镇以传统手工艺为人所知。
groups.chinese_after: 这个镇以传统手工艺闻名。
groups.misuse: 不能为换词把只在小范围有人知道写成广负盛名；区别for与as。
groups.example_origin: 自编迁移练习，不计入真题频次

exercises.prompt: Practice is important for language learning.
exercises.chinese: 练习对于语言学习很重要。
exercises.answer: Practice plays an important role in language learning.
exercises.answer_chinese: 练习在语言学习中发挥重要作用。
exercises.explanation: 介词in后接名词或动名词；强调所起作用。 不要写play an important role to learning。

exercises.prompt: Schools should pay more attention to practical skills.
exercises.chinese: 学校应更加关注实践技能。
exercises.answer: Schools should give greater priority to practical skills.
exercises.answer_chinese: 学校应更加优先培养实践技能。
exercises.explanation: give priority to表示优先处理，强于一般关注。 只有要强调排序上的优先时才替换。

exercises.prompt: Students should learn by doing.
exercises.chinese: 学生应在实践中学习。
exercises.answer: Students should put their knowledge into practice.
exercises.answer_chinese: 学生应将所学知识付诸实践。
exercises.explanation: 前者强调学习方式，后者强调应用已有知识，需要明确这种侧重变化。 不是严格同义：应用知识与获取知识可同时发生，但不能混为一谈。

exercises.prompt: This method is useful for solving complex problems.
exercises.chinese: 这种方法有助于解决复杂问题。
exercises.answer: This method is of use in solving complex problems.
exercises.answer_chinese: 这种方法在解决复杂问题时有用。
exercises.explanation: be of use后接in doing，保持有用之义。 不要写be of useful。

exercises.prompt: Communication is faster because of digital technology.
exercises.chinese: 数字技术使交流更快捷。
exercises.answer: Communication is faster owing to digital technology.
exercises.answer_chinese: 由于数字技术，交流更快捷。
exercises.explanation: 两者后接名词短语；owing to较正式，保留因果关系。 后面完整从句要用because，不能直接owing to technology develops。

exercises.prompt: Students can make use of online resources.
exercises.chinese: 学生可以利用网络资源。
exercises.answer: Students can take advantage of online resources.
exercises.answer_chinese: 学生可以充分利用网络资源。
exercises.explanation: 利用资源时接近；take advantage of人可能表示占便宜。 搭配人时需检查是否变成贬义。

exercises.prompt: Excessive screen time is related to poor sleep.
exercises.chinese: 过长屏幕使用时间与睡眠不佳有关。
exercises.answer: Excessive screen time is associated with poor sleep.
exercises.answer_chinese: 过长屏幕使用时间与睡眠不佳存在关联。
exercises.explanation: 表达关联时接近，均不能自动推导因果。 不能据此改成causes poor sleep。

exercises.prompt: Digital libraries give students access to more books.
exercises.chinese: 数字图书馆让学生能接触更多书籍。
exercises.answer: Digital libraries make more books accessible to students.
exercises.answer_chinese: 数字图书馆使更多书籍可供学生使用。
exercises.explanation: give sb access to sth改为make sth accessible to sb，宾语顺序变化。 accessible修饰资源，不要写make students accessible to books。

exercises.prompt: Graduates should be able to solve practical problems.
exercises.chinese: 毕业生应能够解决实际问题。
exercises.answer: Graduates should be capable of solving practical problems.
exercises.answer_chinese: 毕业生应具备解决实际问题的能力。
exercises.explanation: be able to do改be capable of doing，强调能力。 不要写capable to solve或capable of solve。

exercises.prompt: Employees should try to develop new skills.
exercises.chinese: 员工应努力培养新技能。
exercises.answer: Employees should make an effort to develop new skills.
exercises.answer_chinese: 员工应为培养新技能作出努力。
exercises.explanation: 均表示努力尝试；不保证已成功。 不能改成manage to，因为后者通常表示设法成功。

exercises.prompt: Team leaders should be responsible for their decisions.
exercises.chinese: 团队领导应对自己的决定负责。
exercises.answer: Team leaders should take responsibility for their decisions.
exercises.answer_chinese: 团队领导应承担自己决定的责任。
exercises.explanation: 前者描述责任，后者强调主动承担。 替换后主动承担的语气更强；不适合纯粹陈述岗位归属的所有场景。

exercises.prompt: New employees must learn to deal with workplace pressure.
exercises.chinese: 新员工必须学会处理工作压力。
exercises.answer: New employees must learn to cope with workplace pressure.
exercises.answer_chinese: 新员工必须学会应对工作压力。
exercises.explanation: cope with强调应对困难或压力；deal with范围更广。 deal with a topic表示论述话题，不能换成cope with。

exercises.prompt: In my opinion, small habits can lead to lasting change.
exercises.chinese: 在我看来，小习惯可能带来持久变化。
exercises.answer: From my perspective, small habits can lead to lasting change.
exercises.answer_chinese: 从我的角度看，小习惯可能带来持久变化。
exercises.explanation: 均标明个人观点；后者突出观察角度。 同一篇短文不必每句都用观点提示语。

exercises.prompt: Personal growth requires a lot of patience.
exercises.chinese: 个人成长需要很多耐心。
exercises.answer: Personal growth requires a considerable amount of patience.
exercises.answer_chinese: 个人成长需要相当多的耐心。
exercises.explanation: a considerable amount of仅用于不可数名词；数量可观。 可数复数用a considerable number of，不能amount of people。

exercises.prompt: More and more people are joining volunteer programmes.
exercises.chinese: 越来越多的人参加志愿服务项目。
exercises.answer: An increasing number of people are joining volunteer programmes.
exercises.answer_chinese: 越来越多的人参加志愿服务项目。
exercises.explanation: an increasing number of后接可数复数，谓语用复数。 the number of people表示人数，谓语用单数；不要混淆。

exercises.prompt: Even though the task was difficult, she continued.
exercises.chinese: 尽管任务困难，她仍继续努力。
exercises.answer: Despite the difficulty of the task, she continued.
exercises.answer_chinese: 尽管任务有难度，她仍坚持了下来。
exercises.explanation: even though后接从句；despite后接名词或动名词，需要改结构。 不要写despite of；完整从句可用despite the fact that。

exercises.prompt: Residents should work together to improve the neighbourhood.
exercises.chinese: 居民应合作改善社区。
exercises.answer: Residents should make joint efforts to improve the neighbourhood.
exercises.answer_chinese: 居民应共同努力改善社区。
exercises.explanation: make joint efforts to do强调共同努力实现目标。 只有协调行动或共同努力时适用，不代表所有一起工作。

exercises.prompt: Students should take part in group discussions.
exercises.chinese: 学生应参与小组讨论。
exercises.answer: Students should participate in group discussions.
exercises.answer_chinese: 学生应参与小组讨论。
exercises.explanation: 均表示参与活动，participate较正式。 不要省略participate后面的in。

exercises.prompt: Leaders should think about different opinions before deciding.
exercises.chinese: 领导者作决定前应考虑不同意见。
exercises.answer: Leaders should take different opinions into account before deciding.
exercises.answer_chinese: 领导者作决定前应将不同意见纳入考虑。
exercises.explanation: 后者表示在判断或决策时考虑某因素。 take into account不是想到某个人时的通用替换。

exercises.prompt: I agree with the idea that cooperation improves learning.
exercises.chinese: 我同意合作有助于学习这一观点。
exercises.answer: I share the view that cooperation improves learning.
exercises.answer_chinese: 我赞同合作有助于学习这一看法。
exercises.explanation: agree with an opinion改share the view that从句，明确观点内容。 share不接with the view；与某人分享可用share a view with sb。

exercises.prompt: Severe air pollution is bad for public health.
exercises.chinese: 严重空气污染不利于公众健康。
exercises.answer: Severe air pollution poses a threat to public health.
exercises.answer_chinese: 严重空气污染威胁公众健康。
exercises.explanation: pose a threat to强调威胁，语气强于一般不利。 程度较轻的不便不宜升级为threat。

exercises.prompt: Governments should do something about air pollution.
exercises.chinese: 政府应采取行动处理空气污染。
exercises.answer: Governments should take measures to address air pollution.
exercises.answer_chinese: 政府应采取措施治理空气污染。
exercises.explanation: 后者明确采取措施处理问题；to address后接问题。 address作动词时后面直接接问题，不用address to pollution。

exercises.prompt: Clear warnings can stop people from taking unnecessary risks.
exercises.chinese: 明确警告能阻止人们冒不必要的风险。
exercises.answer: Clear warnings can prevent people from taking unnecessary risks.
exercises.answer_chinese: 明确警告能防止人们冒不必要的风险。
exercises.explanation: 均可表达阻止某人做；正式文体保留from。 from后接动名词，不是动词原形。

exercises.prompt: Excessive waste can lead to environmental damage.
exercises.chinese: 过量废弃物可能导致环境破坏。
exercises.answer: Excessive waste can result in environmental damage.
exercises.answer_chinese: 过量废弃物可能造成环境破坏。
exercises.explanation: 均引出结果；result from引出原因，方向相反。 不要将result in写成result from而保持同一主语。

exercises.prompt: Better transport helps to develop the regional economy.
exercises.chinese: 更好的交通有助于发展区域经济。
exercises.answer: Better transport contributes to regional economic development.
exercises.answer_chinese: 更好的交通有助于区域经济发展。
exercises.explanation: help to do可改contribute to名词/动名词；表示促进而非唯一原因。 contribute to后接developing或development，不用develop。

exercises.prompt: Better services can make the gap between urban and rural areas smaller.
exercises.chinese: 更好的服务可以缩小城乡差距。
exercises.answer: Better services can narrow the gap between urban and rural areas.
exercises.answer_chinese: 更好的服务可以缩小城乡差距。
exercises.explanation: narrow the gap仅适用于缩小差距；保留between A and B。 narrow the gap并不等于eliminate the gap。

exercises.prompt: Public services should meet residents' needs.
exercises.chinese: 公共服务应满足居民需求。
exercises.answer: Public services should respond to residents' needs.
exercises.answer_chinese: 公共服务应回应居民需求。
exercises.explanation: meet强调满足，respond to强调作出回应；结果承诺不同。 回应需求不保证全部满足；需根据论点选择。

exercises.prompt: Community participation is a way to improve public services.
exercises.chinese: 社区参与是改善公共服务的一种方式。
exercises.answer: Community participation is an approach to improving public services.
exercises.answer_chinese: 社区参与是改善公共服务的一种途径。
exercises.explanation: a way to do改an approach to doing；介词to后接动名词。 不要写an approach to improve。

exercises.prompt: Families pass down traditional skills to younger generations.
exercises.chinese: 家庭把传统技艺传给年轻一代。
exercises.answer: Families hand down traditional skills to younger generations.
exercises.answer_chinese: 家庭把传统技艺传承给年轻一代。
exercises.explanation: 传承习俗或知识时接近；均可用from generation to generation。 hand out是分发，不是传承。

exercises.prompt: The region is famous for its traditional crafts.
exercises.chinese: 该地区以传统工艺闻名。
exercises.answer: The region is renowned for its traditional crafts.
exercises.answer_chinese: 该地区因传统工艺而享有盛名。
exercises.explanation: 后者较正式，强调广为人知且通常评价积极。 坏名声通常用notorious for，不能一律用renowned。

exercises.prompt: The exhibition is made up of three sections.
exercises.chinese: 展览由三个部分组成。
exercises.answer: The exhibition consists of three sections.
exercises.answer_chinese: 展览由三个部分组成。
exercises.explanation: 整体由部分组成时接近；consist of无被动形式。 不要写is consisted of。

exercises.prompt: The festival shows the value of local traditions.
exercises.chinese: 文化节展现地方传统的价值。
exercises.answer: The festival highlights the value of local traditions.
exercises.answer_chinese: 文化节凸显地方传统的价值。
exercises.explanation: highlight强调突出某方面的价值，带有强调作用。 突出价值不等于证明所有传统都应原样保留。

exercises.prompt: Regular revision helps students remember new words.
exercises.chinese: 定期复习帮助学生记住新单词。
exercises.answer: Regular revision helps students retain new words.
exercises.answer_chinese: 定期复习帮助学生保留对新单词的记忆。
exercises.explanation: retain强调把已学知识保留在记忆中；remember还可指回想起一次经历。 remember to do表示记得去做，不能改成retain to do。

exercises.prompt: The teacher explained the unclear rule.
exercises.chinese: 老师解释了那条不清楚的规则。
exercises.answer: The teacher clarified the unclear rule.
exercises.answer_chinese: 老师澄清了那条不清楚的规则。
exercises.explanation: clarify着重消除不清楚之处；explain可以详细解释原因，不必暗示原来有歧义。 解释完整历史过程一般用explain，不必改为clarify。

exercises.prompt: Students should review their notes before class.
exercises.chinese: 学生课前应复习笔记。
exercises.answer: Students should go over their notes before class.
exercises.answer_chinese: 学生课前应温习笔记。
exercises.explanation: go over lessons/notes表示复习；较口语，正式文章保留review也很好。 go over用于复习义时后面直接接材料；不写go over about notes。

exercises.prompt: Students need to learn the basic theory well.
exercises.chinese: 学生需要把基础理论学好。
exercises.answer: Students need to develop a solid grasp of the basic theory.
exercises.answer_chinese: 学生需要扎实掌握基础理论。
exercises.explanation: 后者强调形成扎实理解，不一定包含熟练操作；宾语宜为理论、基础知识。 只能在学好强调理解时近似改写；学会游泳不能照搬a grasp of swimming。

exercises.prompt: The sensor provides accurate measurements.
exercises.chinese: 传感器提供准确的测量结果。
exercises.answer: The sensor provides precise measurements.
exercises.answer_chinese: 传感器提供精密的测量结果。
exercises.explanation: accurate侧重结果正确；precise侧重细节或测量精确，二者不总能互换。 重复测量很接近不代表都接近真值；不能把精密与准确混作同一性质。

exercises.prompt: The registration process is easy to understand.
exercises.chinese: 注册流程容易理解。
exercises.answer: The registration process is straightforward.
exercises.answer_chinese: 注册流程简单明了。
exercises.explanation: straightforward表示步骤直接、容易理解，不能替换easy-going等固定组合。 不把an easy person改成a straightforward person；后者通常表示坦率。

exercises.prompt: Digital tools help families keep in touch with one another.
exercises.chinese: 数字工具帮助家人相互保持联系。
exercises.answer: Digital tools help families stay in contact with one another.
exercises.answer_chinese: 数字工具帮助家人相互保持联系。
exercises.explanation: 都可表示与人保持联系；contact在这一用法中不可数。 不写stay in contacts with；不能省去with后的联系对象。

exercises.prompt: Users receive a lot of information every day.
exercises.chinese: 用户每天接收大量信息。
exercises.answer: Users receive a large amount of information every day.
exercises.answer_chinese: 用户每天接收大量信息。
exercises.explanation: information不可数；后者较正式，不改变信息数量多这一基本意思。 不写many informations；可数名词要用a large number of。

exercises.prompt: New employees need practical training.
exercises.chinese: 新员工需要实践培训。
exercises.answer: New employees require practical training.
exercises.answer_chinese: 新员工需要实践培训。
exercises.explanation: require表示需要，语体较正式；此处宾语保持不变，不自动增加法律强制性。 require还可表示要求；require sb to do与sb need to do结构不同。

exercises.prompt: The team has enough time to finish the task.
exercises.chinese: 团队有足够时间完成任务。
exercises.answer: The team has sufficient time to finish the task.
exercises.answer_chinese: 团队有充分时间完成任务。
exercises.explanation: 修饰名词时sufficient置于名词前；enough还可置于形容词之后。 不能把old enough写成old sufficient；sufficient常用于数量或条件。

exercises.prompt: The team is able to solve complex problems.
exercises.chinese: 团队能够解决复杂问题。
exercises.answer: The team is capable of solving complex problems.
exercises.answer_chinese: 团队具备解决复杂问题的能力。
exercises.explanation: capable of后接名词或动名词，强调能力；具体一次成功做成某事时不必改写。 不写capable to solve；过去一次成功完成常用managed to，而非机械替换。

exercises.prompt: She is good at data analysis.
exercises.chinese: 她擅长数据分析。
exercises.answer: She is skilled in data analysis.
exercises.answer_chinese: 她熟练掌握数据分析技能。
exercises.explanation: skilled in突出经过学习形成的技能；good at适用范围更广。 不能把good at making excuses改成职业能力式的skilled in而不看语境。

exercises.prompt: The rules make people's responsibilities clear.
exercises.chinese: 规则让人们的责任清楚明了。
exercises.answer: The rules make people's responsibilities explicit.
exercises.answer_chinese: 规则明确说明人们的责任。
exercises.explanation: explicit强调明确说出、不让人猜测；clear还可指容易理解或看清。 clear water中的clear不能改为explicit；此处加强明确表达这一侧面。

exercises.prompt: People should be careful when sharing personal information.
exercises.chinese: 人们分享个人信息时应小心。
exercises.answer: People should be cautious when sharing personal information.
exercises.answer_chinese: 人们分享个人信息时应谨慎。
exercises.explanation: careful可指做事仔细；cautious着重避免风险，不能把细心一概改成谨慎。 a careful analysis通常是细致分析，不一定是a cautious analysis。

exercises.prompt: Young people should make a choice based on their own goals.
exercises.chinese: 年轻人应根据自身目标作出选择。
exercises.answer: Young people should make a decision based on their own goals.
exercises.answer_chinese: 年轻人应根据自身目标作出决定。
exercises.explanation: 在选择具体行动方案时接近；decision还可指不涉及多个选项的决定。 不能由此把have no choice改成have no decision；固定搭配含义不同。

exercises.prompt: People should keep learning throughout their lives.
exercises.chinese: 人们应终身持续学习。
exercises.answer: People should continue to learn throughout their lives.
exercises.answer_chinese: 人们应终身持续学习。
exercises.explanation: 此处都表示持续进行；continue也可接doing，keep不能直接接to do。 不写keep to learn；keep to另有遵守、不偏离之义。

exercises.prompt: The report says that cooperation is necessary.
exercises.chinese: 报告说合作是必要的。
exercises.answer: The report states that cooperation is necessary.
exercises.answer_chinese: 报告指出合作是必要的。
exercises.explanation: state较正式，强调清楚陈述；可保留that从句。 say hello不能机械替换成state hello；state不能自动证明观点正确。

exercises.prompt: The example shows the value of clear communication.
exercises.chinese: 这个例子显示了清晰沟通的价值。
exercises.answer: The example demonstrates the value of clear communication.
exercises.answer_chinese: 这个例子表明了清晰沟通的价值。
exercises.explanation: demonstrate在证据语境表示清楚表明；show适用范围更广。 show sb a photo通常保留show；不要为正式而改成demonstrate sb a photo。

exercises.prompt: The students discussed whether phones should be allowed in class.
exercises.chinese: 学生讨论课堂上是否应允许使用手机。
exercises.answer: The students debated whether phones should be allowed in class.
exercises.answer_chinese: 学生就课堂是否应允许使用手机展开辩论。
exercises.explanation: debate含讨论不同立场或争议的意味，比一般discuss更强调分歧。 若只是交换安排信息，debate会增加争论意味，不能视为完全等义。

exercises.prompt: Team members should pay attention to quieter colleagues' ideas.
exercises.chinese: 团队成员应关注较少发言同事的想法。
exercises.answer: Team members should give attention to quieter colleagues' ideas.
exercises.answer_chinese: 团队成员应重视较少发言同事的想法。
exercises.explanation: 在关注问题这一语境接近，均保留介词to；后面可接名词或动名词。 to在此为介词；接动词要用doing，不能直接接动词原形。

exercises.prompt: Cities should limit the use of disposable plastic bags.
exercises.chinese: 城市应限制一次性塑料袋的使用。
exercises.answer: Cities should restrict the use of disposable plastic bags.
exercises.answer_chinese: 城市应限制一次性塑料袋的使用。
exercises.explanation: restrict常强调加以约束；用于使用量时接近limit，但语气可能更强。 restrict不等于ban；限制不代表完全禁止。

exercises.prompt: The river is dirty because of industrial waste.
exercises.chinese: 工业废物使这条河很脏。
exercises.answer: The river is polluted by industrial waste.
exercises.answer_chinese: 这条河受到工业废物污染。
exercises.explanation: polluted明确表示受到污染；dirty仅表示不干净，范围更广。 衣服沾灰通常用dirty，不应都写polluted；此处污染原因已明确。

exercises.prompt: The system cleans the water by removing harmful substances.
exercises.chinese: 系统通过去除有害物质清洁水体。
exercises.answer: The system purifies the water by removing harmful substances.
exercises.answer_chinese: 系统通过去除有害物质净化水体。
exercises.explanation: purify强调去除杂质或有害成分；比一般clean更具体，不能保证完全纯净。 打扫房间用clean the room；不写purify the room来代替普通打扫。

exercises.prompt: Some species are in danger because their habitats are shrinking.
exercises.chinese: 一些物种因栖息地缩小而处于危险中。
exercises.answer: Some species are at risk because their habitats are shrinking.
exercises.answer_chinese: 一些物种因栖息地缩小而面临风险。
exercises.explanation: 在受到伤害威胁时接近；at risk of后接风险事件，不能省掉关键条件。 at risk不自动等于已发生损害；不应改写成have become extinct。

exercises.prompt: The city plans to build a network of community services.
exercises.chinese: 城市计划建设社区服务网络。
exercises.answer: The city plans to establish a network of community services.
exercises.answer_chinese: 城市计划建立社区服务网络。
exercises.explanation: establish在创建制度、机制、机构时自然；建筑物实际施工可继续用build。 build a bridge的具体建造义不宜机械换成establish a bridge。

exercises.prompt: These volunteers support older residents in using online services.
exercises.chinese: 这些志愿者帮助老年居民使用在线服务。
exercises.answer: These volunteers assist older residents in using online services.
exercises.answer_chinese: 这些志愿者协助老年居民使用在线服务。
exercises.explanation: assist在帮助人做事时可替换support，但不包含赞同某种观点的含义。 support a policy表示支持政策时不能改成assist a policy。

exercises.prompt: The programme helps students from poor families.
exercises.chinese: 这个项目帮助来自贫困家庭的学生。
exercises.answer: The programme helps students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
exercises.answer_chinese: 这个项目帮助家庭或成长条件不利的学生。
exercises.explanation: poor可指收入低；disadvantaged指处于不利条件，范围可包含教育和机会，不是所有贫困的同义词。 后一表达扩大了范围；需要精确指低收入时用low-income families。

exercises.prompt: Libraries provide residents with free learning resources.
exercises.chinese: 图书馆为居民提供免费学习资源。
exercises.answer: Libraries provide free learning resources for residents.
exercises.answer_chinese: 图书馆向居民提供免费的学习资源。
exercises.explanation: 在为某群体提供物品或服务时可转换，注意对象顺序。 练习中优先使用with或for的完整搭配，明确提供物与接受者的关系。

exercises.prompt: The museum displays objects from very old civilizations.
exercises.chinese: 博物馆展出年代十分久远的文明遗物。
exercises.answer: The museum displays objects from ancient civilizations.
exercises.answer_chinese: 博物馆展出古代文明遗物。
exercises.explanation: ancient表示年代非常久远，比old强；用于古代历史对象时可用。 几十年前的流行歌曲通常是old songs，不能一概称ancient songs。

exercises.prompt: Local communities work to keep the tradition alive.
exercises.chinese: 当地社区努力使传统保持活力。
exercises.answer: Local communities work to maintain the vitality of the tradition.
exercises.answer_chinese: 当地社区努力维持传统的活力。
exercises.explanation: maintain强调使某种状态持续；此处不是keep的保留物品或继续做事用法。 不写maintain doing来替换keep doing；maintain后接名词对象。

exercises.prompt: Students should value the diversity of local traditions.
exercises.chinese: 学生应珍视地方传统的多样性。
exercises.answer: Students should appreciate the diversity of local traditions.
exercises.answer_chinese: 学生应理解并欣赏地方传统的多样性。
exercises.explanation: value强调认为有价值、珍视；appreciate可强调理解其价值或欣赏。 appreciate还可表示感激；value不一定包含欣赏的体验，侧重略变。

exercises.prompt: Families hand down local stories to younger generations.
exercises.chinese: 家庭把地方故事传给年轻一代。
exercises.answer: Families pass on local stories to younger generations.
exercises.answer_chinese: 家庭将地方故事传承给年轻一代。
exercises.explanation: 传承知识、故事、技艺时接近，均可加to引出传承对象。 pass on information也可只是转告消息；不是每处都有文化传承含义。

paragraphs.before: Regular revision helps students remember new words. Teachers can help learning by giving clear feedback. Students should use what they learn to solve practical problems.
paragraphs.after: Regular revision helps students retain new words. Teachers can facilitate learning by giving clear feedback. Students should apply what they learn to practical problems.
paragraphs.chinese: 定期复习帮助学生记住新单词。教师可通过清晰反馈促进学习。学生应把所学运用于实际问题。
paragraphs.review: remember到retain突出记忆保留；help learning到facilitate learning保留过程宾语；use...to solve到apply...to调整结构。保留helps/can/should的语气，不添加考试分数或研究数据。

paragraphs.before: New employees need practical training. They need enough time to improve their skills. Training can help them get ready for future challenges.

paragraphs.chinese: 新员工需要实践培训，也需要足够时间提高技能。培训能帮助他们准备应对未来挑战。
paragraphs.review: require不自动变成强制法律要求；sufficient放在time前；get ready for到prepare for保留对象与can的可能性。
paragraphs.example_origin: 自编段落，不是真题范文

paragraphs.before: People should keep learning throughout their lives. When they make a choice, they should consider their own goals. This habit is good for personal growth.
paragraphs.after: People should continue to learn throughout their lives. When they make a decision, they should consider their own goals. This habit is beneficial to personal growth.
paragraphs.chinese: 人们应终身持续学习，作选择时应考虑自己的目标。这一习惯有益于个人成长。
paragraphs.review: keep doing转continue to do；选择与决定在当前行动语境接近；good for转beneficial to。保留This habit指代，不把建议写成既成事实。
paragraphs.example_origin: 自编段落，不是真题范文

paragraphs.after: The report states that cooperation is necessary. Team members should discuss the plan before acting. They should also give attention to quieter colleagues' ideas.
paragraphs.chinese: 报告指出合作是必要的。成员应在行动前讨论计划，也应关注较少发言同事的想法。
paragraphs.review: state只改变陈述语体，不增加证据；discuss后不带about；关注对象仍是同事的想法，不偷换成强制认同。
paragraphs.example_origin: 自编段落，不是真题范文

paragraphs.before: Cities should limit the use of disposable plastic bags. The campaign makes residents aware of food waste. These measures may help protect the environment.
paragraphs.after: Cities should restrict the use of disposable plastic bags. The campaign raises residents' awareness of food waste. These measures may help safeguard the environment.
paragraphs.chinese: 城市应限制一次性塑料袋的使用。宣传活动使居民认识食物浪费问题。这些措施可能有助于保护环境。
paragraphs.review: restrict不等于ban；提高意识不等于已消除浪费；保留may help，不能写成will solve every environmental problem。
paragraphs.example_origin: 自编段落，不是真题范文

paragraphs.before: Libraries provide residents with free learning resources. Volunteers support older residents in using online services. Together, these services can make daily life easier.
paragraphs.after: Libraries provide free learning resources for residents. Volunteers assist older residents in using online services. Together, these services can make daily life easier.
paragraphs.chinese: 图书馆为居民提供免费学习资源。志愿者帮助老年居民使用在线服务。这些服务共同让日常生活更便利。
paragraphs.review: provide转换时居民仍是接受者；support到assist限于具体协助义；最后一句保留原表达，避免为增加替换数量而硬换。
paragraphs.example_origin: 自编段落，不是真题范文

paragraphs.before: Families hand down local stories to younger generations. Schools can help students understand the value of these traditions. Communities also work to keep the traditions alive.
paragraphs.after: Families pass on local stories to younger generations. Schools can help students understand the value of these traditions. Communities also work to maintain the vitality of the traditions.

paragraphs.review: 传承对象与方向不变；保留understand以强调理解，不偷换成已经珍视；keep...alive改为maintain the vitality of，保留努力过程。

traps.title: 把相关写成因果
traps.wrong: Screen time is associated with poor sleep, so screen time causes poor sleep.
traps.correct: Screen time is associated with poor sleep.
traps.explanation: 相关性不能自动推出因果；若没有额外证据，不能加so causes。

traps.title: 把可能写成必然
traps.wrong: Regular exercise may help reduce stress. → Regular exercise eliminates stress.
traps.correct: Regular exercise may help alleviate stress.
traps.explanation: may、help与reduce的力度均需保留；eliminate是消除，意义过强。

traps.title: 替换对象方向颠倒
traps.wrong: Replace paper forms with online forms. → Substitute paper forms for online forms.
traps.correct: Substitute online forms for paper forms.
traps.explanation: replace A with B与substitute B for A对象顺序相反。

traps.title: 名词可数性错误
traps.correct: Users receive a large amount of information.
traps.explanation: information不可数；a large number of后面接可数名词复数。

traps.title: 主语能力与资源可用性混淆
traps.wrong: Digital libraries make students accessible to books.
traps.correct: Digital libraries make books accessible to students.
traps.explanation: 可获取的是书籍，学生是使用者；宾语与to后的对象不能颠倒。

traps.title: 词尾搭配照抄
traps.wrong: The course facilitates students to learn.
traps.explanation: facilitate后接名词或动名词；enable students to learn是另一种可用结构。

traps.title: 词性不变换就堆高级词
traps.wrong: The policy is benefit to residents.
traps.correct: The policy is beneficial to residents.
traps.explanation: benefit是名词或动词，此处表语用形容词beneficial。

traps.title: 动词后多加介词
traps.wrong: Team members discussed about the plan.
traps.explanation: discuss是及物动词；也可写had a discussion about the plan。

traps.title: 介词后仍用动词原形
traps.wrong: The team is capable to solve the problem.
traps.correct: The team is capable of solving the problem.
traps.explanation: capable of后用名词或动名词；able to后接原形。

traps.title: 趋势被静态数量替代
traps.wrong: More and more students volunteer. → Many students volunteer.
traps.correct: An increasing number of students volunteer.
traps.explanation: many只说明数量多，不保留不断增加的趋势。

traps.title: 无证据加强重要程度
traps.wrong: Feedback is useful. → Feedback is indispensable in every situation.
traps.correct: Feedback is useful in supporting learning.
traps.explanation: useful不自动等于不可或缺，every situation也扩大范围。

traps.title: 把提醒认识写成已经行动
traps.wrong: The campaign raises awareness of food waste. → The campaign ends food waste.
traps.correct: The campaign helps residents recognise the problem of food waste.
traps.explanation: 意识提高与行为改变、问题解决是不同层次。

traps.title: 声称获得固定分数
traps.wrong: Using sophisticated words guarantees a high score.
traps.correct: Use precise words that fit the meaning and grammar.
traps.explanation: 词汇复杂程度不能单独保证成绩；首先保证切题和语言准确。

traps.title: 为了多样而换掉关键术语
traps.wrong: Privacy protection is important. → Secrecy protection is important.
traps.explanation: privacy为隐私权或私人信息边界；secrecy强调保密，不能当成全部等义词。

traps.title: 同主题也不是同义
traps.wrong: Young people need experience. → Young people need expertise.
traps.explanation: 经历或经验并不必然构成专业专长；expertise会提高能力要求。

traps.title: 误改题目规定首句
traps.wrong: 题目要求照抄给定首句，却把其中important换成essential。
traps.correct: 按题目要求照抄给定首句，在后续自写句中练习替换。
traps.explanation: 具体硬性任务以原卷Directions为准；替换练习不能改变必须照抄的文字。
